title: May the 4th: Craft Your Sci-Fi Scene
summary: A May the 4th celebration post providing a Copilot-friendly prompt for generating Star Wars-inspired science fiction scenes by transforming images into heroic characters with sci-fi elements. Not related to Dynamics 365 Business Central.
key_points: Prompt designed to create Star Wars-inspired scenes compatible with Copilot
Transforms subjects into heroic characters in sci-fi settings with space elements
Preserves recognizable traits of people while reimagining objects or animals
Incorporates themed banner and visual elements like laser blasters and alien creatures
